line1:
Five drills, whenever you feel like it.
An account? After you've practised.
line2:
Pitch, intervals, chords, melody, rhythm
— and a bit more confidence at karaoke.

openSource.label: Open source
openSource.body: The code is on GitHub under Apache-2.0 — run your own copy if you like.

price.label: Free
price.body: All five drills are free. An account only remembers where you got to.

fees.label: No extra fees
fees.body: No subscription, no unlock fee, nothing to buy one level at a time.
